If you’ve been feeling “off” and can’t quite explain why, hormones may be worth exploring. They play a major role in how you feel day to day, affecting your mood, energy, metabolism, mental clarity, sleep, and sexual wellness. When hormone levels shift or decline, it can show up in ways that feel frustrating, confusing, or unlike yourself. At Modern Medspa, we offer personalized Biote pellet hormone replacement therapy and bioidentical hormone treatment plans for women and men who want real answers and symptom relief. How Long It Lasts: Pellet therapy typically lasts several months Treatment Process: Consultation + Lab Work + Personalized Plan Downtime: None, however, after placing the pellet you cannot do gluteal exercises or submerge the flank in water for (3 days for women, 5 days for men) Results: Gradual improvement over several weeks Not sure if HRT is right for you? At Modern Medspa, hormone replacement therapy is approached through a whole-person lens. Your symptoms, goals, health history, and lab results all matter when creating the right plan for you. Many patients choose Biote pellet therapy because it provides: Consistent hormone delivery Long-lasting symptom support Fewer hormonal ups and downs Convenience Personalized dosing based on labs and symptoms Support for energy, mood, sleep, libido, and vitality Biote is a form of bioidentical hormone replacement therapy that uses tiny pellets placed beneath the skin to deliver a steady, consistent release of hormones over time. These hormones are designed to closely match those naturally produced by the body. Unlike creams, patches, or daily pills, pellet hormone therapy offers long-lasting support without the need to remember daily dosing. Bioidentical Hormone Replacement Therapy for Women Hormonal shifts can happen during perimenopause, menopause,or simply with age. Symptoms are real, common, and often treatable. Our personalized bioidentical hormone replacement therapy for women may help support: Hot flashes Night sweats Mood swings Low libido Poor sleep Weight changes Brain fog Vaginal dryness Low motivation Fatigue Pellet Hormone Replacement Therapy for Men Hormone levels in men can also decline with age, stress, poor sleep, or other health factors. Low testosterone can affect energy, mood, body composition, motivation, and sexual wellness. HRT CONSULTATION plymouth HRT CONSULTATION hooksett MEDSPA MEMBERSHIPS MEDSPA Packages Specials & Offers payment plans How do I know if I need hormone replacement therapy? + If you’re experiencing symptoms like fatigue, poor sleep, mood changes, low libido, brain fog, or hot flashes, hormone imbalance may be worth evaluating through consultation and lab testing. Who should avoid hormone replacement therapy? + Hormone replacement therapy may not be appropriate for individuals with a current or prior history of estrogen-receptor–positive cancers, including breast, uterine, or ovarian cancer, although testosterone therapy may still be considered in select cases. Patients with a history of blood clots, liver disease, or uncontrolled high blood pressure may require alternative treatment options, which can include lifestyle modifications, nutritional support, or non-hormonal medications. Is hormone replacement therapy safe? + For many patients, hormone therapy can be safe and effective when appropriately prescribed and monitored. Your health history, symptoms, goals, and risk factors all matter when deciding if treatment is right for you. How quickly does hormone replacement therapy work? + Some patients notice changes within a few weeks, while full benefits may continue building over several months. Is hormone replacement therapy only for menopause? + No. Hormone therapy may support both women and men experiencing symptoms related to hormone decline or imbalance. Can I combine HRT with other wellness treatments? + Absolutely. Many patients combine hormone optimization with B12 injections , IV hydration therapy , skincare , or other wellness services based on their goals.
